title: #NoEstimates (Allen Holub)
summary: Allen Holub's keynote arguing that estimation is harmful, particularly in Agile, and presenting planning approaches based on data and flow instead. It covers the distinction between estimation and data-driven prediction.
why: Recommended in estimation and sprint debates as a well-reasoned account of where waste is and isn't in agile.

quote.text: If you want a well-reasoned discussion of where the waste is and isn't, I highly recommend Allen Holub's talk #NoEstimates
